_readme: Edit this file to fit YOUR folder structure — it's the one file you're expected to customize. Nothing in here is code; rebuild the index after any change and your notes/status in overrides.db are untouched. See README.md > 'Customizing classification' for the full guide.

nested_application_markers._comment: DISABLED EXAMPLE. This recreates a pattern from the original author's setup: a state workforce-center folder whose 'Jobs Applied For/<Month>/<Company>/' subfolders should each be tracked as a real application, while everything else directly in that folder (case-management reports, workshop notices) stays grouped as one compliance item instead of being counted as a fake job application. Set enabled to true and change 'folder' to match your own government/compliance folder name if you have a similar setup (e.g. a state unemployment/workforce portal that requires proof of job-search activity).
